name: stage2
about: The stage2 loader, from stage1's handoff to its payload's /init: it binds the config it was handed (stdin) into PCR15. The config bytes are the user-data document verbatim when _stage2 was admitted directly, or stage1's re-serialization of the manifest-merged document when it was resolved through a signed manifest. A verifier needs only their sha256, which the operator can disclose without the contents (stage2 records it in /run/lockboot/stage2.attest); the hash hides the config only if it is not guessable, so include a random nonce if that matters. Same for both arches; static (workspace tools/pcr-replay verifies it).

config.about: sha256 of the exact config bytes stage2 received on stdin

events.about: TPM2_PCR_Extend with the raw sha256(config), sha256 bank only (tpm-derive extend_config_pcr); other banks' PCR15 stay at reset
